correctness.rationale: The product-sphere tangent dimension is (d+1)(d-1)=d^2-1; skew rotations have dimension d(d-1)/2, symmetric traceless variations split into V dimension d and W dimension (d+1)(d-2)/2. Differentiating the two zero residuals gives Hessian quadratic form 2a||Ds||²+2b||DQ||². The explicit norm ratios yield lambda_v=2a(d²-1)/d+8b(d+1)/d² and lambda_q=8b(d+1)/d, with zero only on rotations. The difference factors 2(d²-1)(a-4b/d)/d. This also checks the delicate unnormalized weights and exact d>=3 domain. Independently rebuilt Euclidean tangent matrices for d=3,4,5 and three weight pairs each; all spectra and multiplicities agreed. Finite tests corroborate rather than prove all d.
